title: CTC vs In-Hand Salary: How to Calculate Take-Home Pay Under the New Labour Codes
seoTitle: CTC to In-Hand Salary: Take-Home Under New Labour Codes
seoDescription: CTC to in-hand salary: subtract employer PF, gratuity, your PF, professional tax and tax. See 6, 10 and 15 LPA examples under the 50% wage rule.
excerpt: Worked breakdowns at 6, 10 and 15 LPA show how the 50% wage rule, the new ₹25,000 PF ceiling and new-regime tax change your monthly pay, plus a checklist for reading an offer letter.
